limits: Hosted macOS fixture CI, when passing, is separate from end-user device, external-drive and full APFS acceptance.
Only Python 3.13.13 was run; Python 3.10 grammar was checked.
POSIX advisory locks cannot prevent noncooperating writers; no universal concurrency guarantee.
No universal duplicate scanner, dependency cleaner, ownership oracle, semantic content validator or reconstruction proof.
Agent must truthfully establish purpose, ownership, references, idle state and reconstruction dependencies; JSON assertions cannot create evidence.
Large original reconstruction inputs are metadata-checked, not fully hashed; producer-evidence overlap reads are explicitly counted.
Profile semantic coverage remains incomplete; independently complete candidate scopes may qualify separately.
Shared state, sessions, indexes, credentials, source, original assets, databases, recovery, delivery and unique AI outputs remain protected by default.
Project roots enclosing configured state roots are refused by executors; configured sqlite_home must be supplied as the tool process CODEX_SQLITE_HOME protection hint.
Real NTFS features and APFS clone/snapshot semantics are not qualified by the exFAT fixture regressions.
External targets can disconnect after acceptance; future reachability is not guaranteed.
